faq.title: Frequently asked questions
faq.subtitle: Everything you need to know before booking your ride.

questions.q: What information do I need to provide?
questions.a: Please provide your details as completely as possible: full address (with number), your name, phone number and flight number. This will allow us to take you to and from the right place on time.

questions.q: How far in advance should I book?
questions.a: You can book your taxi online in advance easily. Need a taxi quickly? Contact us directly at +31 (0) 66 666 6666.

questions.q: Will I receive a booking confirmation?
questions.a: Yes, you will immediately receive a confirmation email with your booking number, trip details and your driver's contact information.

questions.q: Can I modify or cancel my booking?
questions.a: You can modify or cancel your booking up to 2 hours before the trip by contacting us by phone or email. Late cancellations may incur charges.
We exclusively use fixed prices calculated in advance: €4 base fare + €2.50/km. You know the exact price before confirming, with no nasty surprises on arrival.
We accept credit cards (Visa, Mastercard, American Express), PayPal and iDEAL. Payment is made online at the time of booking, 100% securely.

questions.q: Are there extra charges per passenger?
questions.a: No, our price is calculated per trip, not per passenger. Whether you are 1 or 4 passengers in a sedan, the price remains the same. For groups of more than 4 people, a van is recommended.
Yes, a detailed invoice is automatically sent by email after your trip. It is perfect for your professional expense reports.

questions.q: How much luggage can I bring?
questions.a: A sedan can accommodate up to 3 suitcases in the boot and 2 hand luggage items. For more luggage, opt for the van which offers a much larger loading space.

questions.q: I have bulky luggage, what should I do?
questions.a: Note it in your booking notes. We will adapt the vehicle accordingly. For bicycles, foldable wheelchairs or ski equipment, contact us directly.

questions.q: Can I travel with my pet?
questions.a: Yes, pets are accepted in a transport cage. Please mention it in the booking notes so we can assign a compatible driver.
Yes, we offer baby seats and boosters. Indicate your child's age and weight in the booking notes so we can provide the right seat.
